issues.detail: '[saved]' starts on its group's first lifeline (PlantUML usually draws it there); keep it short, or start the group at a participant further left

2 of 13 messages cross the lifelines between their participants (UserManager (via LibraryFacade) - Student / Librarian Factory: 1 message(s) over 1 lifeline(s), UserRegistry - PersistenceManager (JPA, MySQL): 1 message(s) over 1 lifeline(s)); reorder participants so most messages go between neighbours
